newsitem.title: USA: Boston Edison to announce phone and cable venture.
newsitem.headline: Boston Edison to announce phone and cable venture.

text.p: Boston Edison is set to announce a joint venture with C-TECH Corp that will allow Massachusetts customers to one day get phone service, cable television and Internet access from their electricity supplier, a spokesman said.
Boston Edison spokesman Mike Monahan said the agreement, valued at $300 million, "means one-stop shopping" for the utility's 650,000 customers in 39 eastern Massachusetts municipalities.
The deal would give C-TECH's Residential Communications Network access to Edison's fiber-optic network and would allow the utility to offer additional services to its customers, Monahan said.
Chief executive officers from both Boston Edison and Princeton, N.J.-based C-TECH are expected to formally unveil details of the joint venture at a press conference later on Monday.
